# Leveling a Paladin — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on holy (1 member), protection (9 members), retribution (10 members). The main line is **retribution** — Endgame build (level 60), 11/8/32, with a respec at level 60. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/paladin/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

### Holy

#### Levels 10–19

- **7 — Redemption** (`PH16-redemption`, level 12+) — When: not in combat; a dead party member within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; mana at least 32%; no party member below 40% health.
- **20 — Blessing of Wisdom** (`PH02-blessing-of-wisdom`, level 14+) — When: not in combat; the target does not have Blessing of Wisdom; at least 30 mana; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **30 — Seal of Wisdom** (`PH03-seal-of-wisdom`, level 18+) — When: (in combat or character level at least 60 and the tank is about to pull); the resident does not have Seal of Wisdom; at least 65 mana.
- **40 — Lay on Hands** (`PH04-lay-on-hands`, level 10+) — When: target health below 15%; Lay on Hands is off cooldown.

#### Levels 20–29

- **-107 — Use Elixir of Fortitude** (`PH00u-fortitude`, level 25+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of Fortitude; Elixir of Fortitude is off cooldown; the resident does not have Health II.
- **9 — Concentration Aura** (`PH01c-concentration-aura`, level 22+) — When: the party has a living member; the resident does not have Concentration Aura; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **95 — Flash of Light** (`PH09t-flash-of-light-tank`, level 20+) — When: in combat; target health below 75%; the resident is not moving; mana at least 40%; at least 35 mana.
- **100 — Flash of Light** (`PH09-flash-of-light`, level 20+) — When: target health below 70%; the resident is not moving; at least 35 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

#### Levels 30–39

- **50 — Divine Shield** (`PH05-divine-shield`, level 34+) — When: own health below 20%; Divine Shield is off cooldown; at least 75 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **80 — Holy Shock** (`PH08-holy-shock`, level 30+) — When: (own health below 40% or the lowest party health below 40%); Holy Shock is off cooldown; at least 280 mana.
- **84 — Cleanse** (`PH11m-cleanse-must`, level 30+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **110 — Cleanse** (`PH11-cleanse`, level 30+) — When: (the target has a dispellable magic effect or the target has a dispellable disease effect or the target has a dispellable poison effect); mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

#### Levels 40–49

- **-110 — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil** (`PH00u-wizard-oil`, level 45+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Wizard Oil; (the main hand does not have Brilliant Wizard Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **-109 — Use Mageblood Potion** (`PH00u-mageblood`, level 40+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Mageblood Potion; Mageblood Potion is off cooldown; the resident does not have Mana Regeneration.
- **-108 — Use Dreamshard Elixir** (`PH00u-dreamshard`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Dreamshard Elixir; Dreamshard Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Dreamshard Elixir.
- **-103 — Apply Wizard Oil** (`PH00u-wizard-oil-lesser`, level 40+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Wizard Oil; (the main hand does not have Wizard Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking; does not carry Brilliant Wizard Oil.

#### Levels 50–59

- **-104 — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea** (`PH00u-tea`, level 55+) — When: in combat; mana below 25%; carries Nordanaar Herbal Tea; Nordanaar Herbal Tea is off cooldown.

#### Levels 60–60

- **83 — Judgement** (`PH14j-judgement-of-wisdom`, level 60+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is within 10 yd; Judgement is off cooldown; the resident has Seal of Wisdom; at least 65 mana; the lowest party health at least 45%; (the target does not have Judgement of Wisdom or the target's Judgement of Wisdom time left is less than 3 s).
- **85 — Holy Strike** (`PH15h-holy-strike-aoe-heal`, level 60+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; Holy Strike is off cooldown; at least 3 party members below 90% health; the lowest party health at least 35%; the resident does not have Divine Protection; the resident does not have Divine Protection; at least 5 mana.
- **86 — Holy Light** (`PH10j-holy-light-judgement-tank`, level 60+) — When: in combat; target health below 60%; (the resident has Holy Judgement or the resident has Holy Judgement or the resident has Holy Judgement); the resident is not moving; at least 35 mana; the target lives at least 2 s.
- **88 — Flash of Light** (`PH09f-flash-of-light-main-heal`, level 60+) — When: target health below 75%; the resident is not moving; at least 35 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

### Protection

#### Levels 10–19

#### Levels 40–49

- **-110 — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil** (`PP00u-wizard-oil`, level 45+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Wizard Oil; (the main hand does not have Brilliant Wizard Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **-109 — Use Elixir of Superior Defense** (`PP00u-superior-defense`, level 43+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of Superior Defense; Elixir of Superior Defense is off cooldown; the resident does not have Greater Armor.
- **-107 — Use Greater Stoneshield Potion** (`PP00u-greater-stoneshield-boss`, level 46+) — When: in combat; the target is a dungeon boss; the tank has opened threat on the target; own health at least 60%; the resident does not have Greater Stoneshield; carries Greater Stoneshield Potion; Greater Stoneshield Potion is off cooldown.
- **-103 — Use Greater Arcane Elixir** (`PP00u-greater-arcane`, level 47+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Greater Arcane Elixir; Greater Arcane Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Greater Arcane Elixir.
- **-102 — Use Dreamshard Elixir** (`PP00u-dreamshard`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Dreamshard Elixir; Dreamshard Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Dreamshard Elixir.
- **-101 — Use Elixir of the Mongoose** (`PP00u-mongoose`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of the Mongoose; Elixir of the Mongoose is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of the Mongoose.
- **111 — Bulwark of the Righteous** (`PP11b-bulwark-boss-pull`, level 42+) — When: in combat; the target is a dungeon boss; in melee range; Bulwark of the Righteous is off cooldown; at least 200 mana.

#### Levels 50–59

- **-106 — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea** (`PP00u-tea`, level 55+) — When: in combat; mana below 25%; carries Nordanaar Herbal Tea; Nordanaar Herbal Tea is off cooldown.
- **19 — Sanctity Aura** (`PP02s-sanctity-aura`, level 53+) — When: the resident does not have Sanctity Aura; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

#### Levels 60–60

- **99 — Consecration** (`PP10q-consecration-rank-1-before-contact`, level 60+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; not in melee range; the target is within 12 yd; at least 3 engaged enemies within 15 yd; Consecration is off cooldown; at least 120 mana; not (time since the resident cast Consecration is more than 20 s and mana at least 30% and at least 505 mana); not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.
- **101 — Consecration** (`PP10r-consecration-rank-1`, level 60+) — When: in combat; at least 3 engaged enemies within 8 yd; Consecration is off cooldown; at least 120 mana; not (time since the resident cast Consecration is more than 20 s and mana at least 30% and at least 505 mana); not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.

### Retribution

#### Levels 10–19

- **7 — Redemption** (`PR00r-redemption`, level 12+) — When: not in combat; a dead party member within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 399 mana.
- **10 — Retribution Aura** (`PR01-retribution-aura`, level 16+) — When: the resident does not have Retribution Aura; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); not (in combat and the lowest party health below 0% and the resident has Concentration Aura and own health below 70%); the resident does not have Sanctity Aura.
- **19 — Blessing of Wisdom** (`PR02w-blessing-of-wisdom-self`, level 14+) — When: not in combat; the target does not have Blessing of Wisdom; at least 30 mana; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **25 — Seal of Wisdom** (`PR02a-seal-of-wisdom-oom`, level 18+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; mana below 30%; at most 1 engaged enemy within 30 yd; the resident does not have Seal of Wisdom; target health at least 20%; at least 65 mana.

- **51 — Hand of Protection** (`PR05h-hand-of-protection`, level 10+) — When: in combat; the party has a living member; the target is farther than 0 yd; the target is within 30 yd; target health below 40%; the target does not have Forbearance; Hand of Protection is off cooldown; at least 25 mana.

#### Levels 20–29

- **85 — Exorcism** (`PR08a-exorcism`, level 20+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; (the target is Undead or the target is Demon); the target is within 30 yd; Exorcism is off cooldown; at least 85 mana.
- **120 — Consecration** (`PR12-consecration`, level 20+) — When: at least 4 engaged enemies within 8 yd; the target is within 8 yd; Consecration is off cooldown; mana above 50%; at least 120 mana; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.
- **123 — Consecration** (`PR12l-consecration-three-mobs-leveller`, level 20+) — When: character level below 60; at least 3 engaged enemies within 8 yd; the target is within 8 yd; Consecration is off cooldown; mana above 50%; at least 120 mana; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.
- **150 — Flash of Light** (`PR15-flash-of-light`, level 20+) — When: own health below 35%; the resident is not moving; at least 35 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

#### Levels 30–39

- **60 — Divine Shield** (`PR06-divine-shield`, level 34+) — When: own health below 20%; Divine Shield is off cooldown; at least 75 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **105 — Cleanse** (`PR13m-cleanse-must`, level 30+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **130 — Cleanse** (`PR13-cleanse`, level 30+) — When: (the target has a dispellable magic effect or the target has a dispellable disease effect or the target has a dispellable poison effect); mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

#### Levels 40–49

- **-109 — Use Elixir of the Mongoose** (`PR00u-mongoose`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of the Mongoose; Elixir of the Mongoose is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of the Mongoose.
- **115 — Hammer of Wrath** (`PR11a-hammer-of-wrath`, level 44+) — When: the target is hostile; target health below 20%; the target is within 30 yd; Hammer of Wrath is off cooldown; at least 295 mana; (character level below 60 or time since the resident cast Crusader Strike is less than 3500 ms or time since the resident cast Holy Strike is less than 3500 ms).

- **99 — Holy Strike** (`PR10h-holy-strike-holy-might`, level 60+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; Holy Strike is off cooldown; time since the resident cast Holy Strike is at least 14 s; the resident does not have Divine Protection; the resident does not have Divine Protection; at least 5 mana.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Holy

- **PH16-redemption:** OQ-2765's check, and this file had the same shape as the priest's: PH16 sat at priority 160, below every buff, every defensive, both heals, both cleanses, the interrupt and both offensive rules - fifteenth of sixteen ability rules, above only the vendor and loot actions this class shares with every other spec. `Rotation::rules` is sorted ascending and stops at the first true rule, so a dead party member competed against Devotion Aura, Blessing of Wisdom, Seal of Wisdom, Lay on Hands, Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection, Holy Shock, Holy Light, Flash of Light, Cleanse, Purify, Hammer of Justice, Judgement and Holy Strike, every one of which outranked raising the tank.
- **PH01c-concentration-aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-095 (orchestrator rank 4, round 106): the holy paladin in a PARTY keeps Concentration Aura (spell 19746, level 22): the guide table names it for pushback from mobs hitting the caster (paladin/leveling.md L174, L244: for self-healing with Spiritual Focus), and a healer is the member whose casts are pushed back. Devotion Aura waits while it is up.
- **PH01-devotion-aura:** Free, no duration, no stance gate; the aura a healer keeps because armour helps the whole party and nothing else competes for the slot. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PH02-blessing-of-wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. The holy paladin's one blessing is Wisdom (holy.md L136), so no second blessing rule replaces it (one blessing per paladin per target, SpellEntry.h).
- **PH03-seal-of-wisdom:** The seal this spec keeps: 65 mana for 30 s, and its judgement returns mana to the party. Re-sealed only in combat, because a 30 s aura spent out of combat is wasted mana.
- **PH05-divine-shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PH07-divine-protection:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PH10j-holy-light-judgement-tank:** HO-TKB-PLAY-221: "Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff: Holy Light (1.5 s)" (holy.md L23, L27, L139). The tank under 60 per cent with the buff up (Judgement casts it: PH14j) gets the fast Holy Light before Flash of Light; without the buff the tank gets Flash of Light (PH09f).
- **PH09f-flash-of-light-main-heal:** Level 60 and above only: the heal target (the runtime's pick, tank first) under 75 per cent gets Flash of Light before the Judgement-gated Holy Light (PH10 below) and before the old tank/other Flash of Light rules, which stay for the levellers.
- **PH14j-judgement-of-wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-221: "Keep up: Seal of Wisdom, and Judgement of Wisdom on a long-lived target. Spend a GCD on Judgement + re-seal after a fast Holy Light or when the debuff is about to drop", "Seal of Wisdom -> Judgement of Wisdom -> Seal of Wisdom, Holy Strike, Illumination ... plenty enough for Paladin to never run out of mana" (holy.md L3, L28, L142, L185).
- **PH10-holy-light:** The archive's single-target order is Judgement, then "Holy Light: big tank damage, right after a judgement (1.5-s cast)", then Holy Shock, then the melee strikes, and only then "Flash of Light: filler for moderate damage". HO-TKB-PLAY-221 (holy 13/38/0, Holy Judgement 3/3 in the build): from level 60 Holy Light is the Judgement-gated exception, cast only with the Holy Judgement buff up (spells 51305, 51307, 51309 are its three ranks' buffs; each Judgement makes the next Holy Light 1 s faster, 2.5 s to 1.5 s: spell 51304 and kin, tkbplay-221.result.txt): "Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff: Holy Light", "a 1.5-second Holy Light after each Judgement for big tank hits", "do not spam max-rank Holy Light", "the classic mistake" (holy.md L3, L23, L27, L113, L138-L139, L189).
- **PH09-flash-of-light:** Unlike the priest, the shaman and the druid this spec needed no damage reserve: its two offensive rules, PH14-judgement and PH15-holy-strike, are its mana engine rather than a drain (Seal of Wisdom and Illumination), which HO-TKB-PLAY-001 established and TKBP-C3 records. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PH11m-cleanse-must:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **PH11-cleanse:** Item-taught at 30 (the fifth path); three dispel effects, so it covers magic (1), disease (3) and poison (4) in one global, which is why it outranks Purify. The rule had no mana gate at all and now carries the 30 per cent reserve the priest's cleanses carry (OQ-2803, OQ-2519; HO-TKB-PLAY2-001).
- **PH12-purify:** Item-taught at 6, two effects only, disease and poison. Live from 6 and left below PH11, which the loop reaches first once Cleanse is known. manaCostPercentage 8 like Cleanse, about 44 mana at 25, not free (OQ-2803, OQ-2519; HO-TKB-PLAY2-001).
- **PH13-hammer-of-justice:** The interrupt, such as it is: a stun at 10 yd for 30 mana on a 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, so it is spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **PH14-judgement:** 10 s recoveryTime, 10 yd, and it consumes the seal PH03 keeps, so a judgement costs its own price plus the 65 mana of the re-seal. Neither half is free and the earlier note said the first half was: Judgement (20271) carries manaCost 0 and manaCostPercentage 6, a share of BASE mana at every level, about 33 at level 25 against a base of 552, so the cycle is 98 mana every 10 s.
- **PH15-holy-strike:** Nothing below the heal ladder spends a global while anyone in the party needs a heal. `doc research/tkb/play/r25-heal-vs-purge.txt` HO-TKB-PLAY-021: NOT UNDER DIVINE PROTECTION, the guard the protection and retribution strikes gained (Divine Protection lays SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY, aura 25, so a strike under it fails SPELL_FAILED_PACIFIED; 65 such failures on the two melee paladins in round thirty-four, r34-cast-audit.txt).
- **PH00u-wizard-oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 250); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PH00u-mageblood:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 24363 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 252); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).

It replaces Retribution Aura from level 60 (the leveller's build has no Sanctity Aura): PR01 and PR01a carry `not aura_self(20218)`, and the solo Concentration Aura rules (PR01c and the guard below) keep their say: with nobody to heal and under 50 per cent health (or Concentration up under 70) this rule waits, so the two cannot swap each other.

PR01 and PR01a hold while it is up in a solo fight under 70 per cent, so the heals that follow are not pushed back; out of combat or at 70 they put Retribution Aura back.

- **PR02-blessing-of-might:** ONE blessing rule on purpose: a paladin holds one blessing per target (SpellEntry.h IsSingleFromSpellSpecificPerTargetPerCaster), so a second blessing rule would replace this one on the same member and the two would alternate. Which blessing: "Blessing of Might/Wisdom" for any spec at 1-30 (synthesis/classes/paladin/leveling.md L83); the archive's solo ret puts Wisdom on himself (leveling.md L112, L257), but a Wisdom rule for everyone would take Might off the bear tank, and per-class blessings need a class on the friendly view or a selector that skips the resident (OQ-2593).

PR03a (below) casts Seal of Righteousness out of combat and PR03 then casts Seal of Command over it as soon as combat starts (PR03 only asks for no Command and no Wisdom), a second seal cast and global at every pull; this rule puts the same Command rank 1 that PR03 casts (HO-TKB-PLAY-122) up first, with PR03a's exclusions.
